record.title: Shiveekhuren–Ceke coal-export closure and trial reopening
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.imposing_authority: Mongolian State Emergency Commission and border authorities
record.enforcement: SouthGobi reports suspended exports from February 11 through March 27, 2020. The UB Post describes 35 coal trucks crossing Shiveekhuren on March 28 under a controlled trial; the later ministerial account does not establish normal capacity.
record.relationship: Sibling R3-EA-005; distinct gate-specific end. EA003 covers passengers and is not coal reopening evidence.
record.status_observation: Trial coal traffic resumed March 28; ministerial reopening report followed March 30.
record.uncertainty: March 28 is demonstrated trial access; March 30 ministerial account does not quantify a wider restart. Market-source overlap with exporters is unknown.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated partial reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure. Closure-to-first-trial interval only; not time to full normalization.

Shiveekhuren–Ceke coal exports only; not a full passenger reopening.
